# Docspot

> Docs search and Ask AI for React. Docspot provides the ⌘K search dialog and the chat panel; the site provides a search function, an AI SDK chat transport, and its routing. Published on npm as `docspot`.

## Docs

- [Package README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/francoischalifour/docspot/main/packages/docspot/README.md): installation, usage, composition, props, providers, customization, history, URLs, and accessibility
- [Types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/francoischalifour/docspot/main/packages/docspot/src/types.ts): every public type, documented

## Examples

- [Docs](https://github.com/francoischalifour/docspot/tree/main/examples/docs): search and chat
- [Chat only](https://github.com/francoischalifour/docspot/tree/main/examples/chat-only): chat with a streaming backend
